objective: Implement only P2 — Sleep session: Plan → Begin Sleep → Wake → Journal using manual anchors.
acceptance: The SLEEP top-level route is a real P2 feature rather than the P1 foundation placeholder.
The sleep plan reads and can persist the existing DataStore sleep target without introducing a second settings store.
Begin Sleep persists exactly one active manual sleep-session start anchor in Room and prevents a second concurrent active session.
An active manual session enters a quiet Sleep Mode with the normal bottom navigation hidden and can be restored from persisted Room state after process recreation.
Manual wake records an end anchor and transitions the session to WAKE_PENDING without implementing P3 estimation or P6 morning finalization.
An accidental active session can transition to ABORTED and aborted sessions are excluded from Journal history.
JOURNAL is a real P2 feature that shows persisted ended non-aborted manual session windows and useful loading, empty, and error states.
Pure Kotlin sleep-session transition tests cover begin, wake, abort, invalid transition, and invalid time-order behavior.
No Sleep API, Activity Recognition permission, sleep resolver/confidence, progression, expedition, morning confirmation, or morning reveal behavior is added in P2.
